item.title: PSD blend mode
item.description: Blend Mode for Layers Kwik supports the following Photoshop blend modes. If you are using one not listed below, you will need to merge layers in Photoshop otherwise an image in Simulator is not rendered as same as one in Photoshop. Normal Multiply Screen Linear Dodge TODO example images in photoshop & solar2d simulator

item.title: PSD Naming Rule
item.description: Naming .psd file anad layers in documents Project and file names Avoid long names for your projects and files and, DO NOT use characters like +-<>%,#;!. Layer names Before you start adding buttons and animations, follow the rules below. It is much easier to add interactivity with finalized names rather than to edit all of them afterward. Basic rules include: Only user Western characters are allowed for layer names. DO NOT use characters such as + - <> %,#;!. for naming layers

item.title: PSD Screen Size Orientation
item.description: Kwik Actions .atn In Photoshop/book folder, you find .atn files for Photoshop Actions you can install it from Actions panel’s sub menu (Humberger icon) > Load Actions 1024x768 to iPhone(2776x1440) Step1. Show Safe Area 1920x1280 select All the layers, and expand them Step2. Show 2776 x 1440 Select the background layer Transform to cover the rect of 2776x1440 Use even width/height images width/height should be even number, it enables to use bilinear interpolation

item.title: Kwik Exporter
item.description: Kwik Exporter Panel This is the main panel for the Kwik Exporter plugin in Photoshop. Settings Photoshop Files Open Click “Open” to pick a folder containing your PSD files. The demo project includes two sample PSDs. A kwikconfig.json file will be created to save your settings. Double-click a PSD name in the list to open it in Photoshop. For example, the sample-projects/SingleBook/photoshop folder contains: landscape.psd portrait.psd kwikconfig.json { "name": "book single", "output": "../../Solar2D/src/App/book", "pages": [ {"psd": "portrait.psd", "name": "portrait"} ], "ignored": [ {"psd": "landscape.psd", "name": "landscape"} ] } kwikconfig.json is automatically created in the selected folder to store the list of PSD files and the output path for your Solar2D project.

item.description: you have published .psd files with kwik exporter. The images are the code for Solar2D are available in the output folder - App/book. item.title: Component & Asset
item.description: First of all, you need to put media files into each folder under App/book/assets. Use Finder(Mac) or File Explore (Win), and copy&paste your pre-made files into them. The folder names under App/book/assets are fixed for kwik editor to use them, so don’t change it. App/book/asset kwik editor lists media files under App/book/assets folder you may create a sub folder, for instance “myvideo” folder in videos folder kwik edior > asset view

item.title: Copy & Paste components
item.description: how to work with copy & paste A page editing references a base page as a master template, or a desing patterns for animations, buttons Copy a component such as animation(liner spin etc), button, sprite, audio, and action etc from a master or template page to another page. reuse a consistent set of layered components across different destinations. Copy one component or action from a reference page to a destination.
